subject: Temporary throttle elevation & reconciliation for Aug campaign
messages:
From: Meena Rao <meena@cartful.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cartful.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short-term throttle bump request for Aug 24-26 (campaign spike)

Hi Ben —

Quick note from Cartful: we hit a much larger-than-expected traffic spike starting this morning due to an influencer drop. Our app is hitting the concurrency/throughput ceiling; latency is rising for key customer flows.

Can Redwood provision a short-horizon throttle elevation for the next 48 hours (aiming for +3x concurrent capacity) and confirm how the overrun will be reconciled?

Two asks from procurement side:
- A one-time prorated invoice for the uplift window (we expect ~36 hours of elevated traffic).
- Cartful is asking for a good-faith shortfall rebate given this was a single marketing event — hoping for a discretionary credit tied to the overrun (we proposed a 15% rebate on the uplift portion).

I attached our capacity request spreadsheet (cartful_capacity_request.xlsx) with expected QPS and token estimates. If you need a PO I can route it from procurement (PO_67841 attached in a follow-up).

We need a quick yes/no so engineering can route traffic. Thanks — appreciate the fast help.

—Meena
Meena Rao
Head of Platform Engineering, Cartful
meena@cartful.com

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Meena Rao <meena@cartful.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term throttle bump request for Aug 24-26 (campaign spike)

Meena — thanks for the heads up and for the spreadsheet. We can support a temporary throttle elevation; here are two paths that would get you live quickly:

Option A — Provisional uplift (fastest):
- +3x concurrency for a defined window (you specify start/end).
- Billing: prorated pay-as-you-go at the on-demand uplift rate; invoice on your next billing cycle.
- Reconciliation: usage measured by minute-level metering; no commitment change.

Option B — Short-term reserved overlay (recommended if >24h):
- Temporary reserved capacity block for 48–72 hours.
- Billing: blended rate (discounted vs on-demand) subject to a short-term true-up.

Regarding the rebate: we can offer a one-time discretionary rebate on the uplift portion, conditional on PO and acceptance of our shortfall true-up terms. Typical ceiling we can authorize from Commercial is 10–20% (need manager approval). Please confirm the exact uplift window and whether you’ll provide a PO now or after we confirm terms.

I attached a provisional-pricing-matrix.csv with quick numbers for the two options.

If you want, I can loop in Laura for approval on the rebate cap and Rishi in billing for the true-up mechanics.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, Meena Rao <meena@cartful.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term throttle bump request for Aug 24-26 (campaign spike)

Looping in Billing so we can finalize terms quickly. Ben — thanks for the options. Commercial stance here: we can approve a discretionary rebate up to 20% of the uplift charges for a single-event spike, provided the following are agreed up front:

1) Exact uplift window (start + end timestamps).
2) PO or signed email from procurement confirming acceptance of prorated uplift charges and reconciliation cadence.
3) Customer agrees to the true-up calculation (we will invoice uplift usage; any rebate will be issued as a credit on the following invoice after usage is reconciled).

We will not change baseline committed capacity for this event. This is explicitly a one-off accommodation. Rishi — please provide the short-form billing language we can send to Cartful for PO/signature (surcharge rates, prorate formula, credit timing).

Meena — if you can confirm your preferred option and the window I’ll route formal approval.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Meena Rao <meena@cartful.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Billing terms — temporary throttle elevation (Cartful)

Hi Meena / Laura —

Billing language for the short-horizon uplift: please review and confirm. We will convert into a one-page amendment once you accept.

Summary: temporary throttle elevation ("Uplift Window")
- Measurement: minute-level metering by token and concurrency.
- Rate: on-demand uplift surcharge at $0.00045 per token for uplifted consumption OR a blended reserved uplift at $0.00032 per token if the customer elects Option B and provides PO for 48–72h.
- Prorate: billing prorated to the minute for the exact Uplift Window.
- True-up & credit: Redwood will invoice the uplifted usage on the next invoice cycle. If a discretionary rebate is approved (up to 20% of uplifted charges), the rebate will appear as a credit on the invoice following the reconciliation period (typically 30 days after Uplift Window close).
- Documentation: Redwood requires PO_67841 or signed amendment (DocuSign link below) before enactment.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/---/CF-67841
Draft amendment: draft-amendment.docx

If you confirm the window and which option you choose I will prepare the one-page amendment and issue an interim invoice template for PO processing.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Meena Rao <meena@cartful.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, procurement@cartful.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 18:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing terms — temporary throttle elevation (Cartful)

Thanks Rishi / Laura / Ben —

Cartful accepts Option B (48h reserved overlay) and the blended uplift rate of $0.00032 per token for the uplift portion. Uplift window: 2026-08-24T15:00:00Z to 2026-08-26T15:00:00Z (approximately 48 hours).

Procurement will issue PO_67841 today (attached). Please send the one-page amendment in DocuSign so we can get signatures and have your engineering team trigger the overlay.

We appreciate the discretionary rebate ceiling of 20% for this single event; request that the credit posts as requested (invoice following reconciliation).

—Meena
Meena Rao
